summary: Verified Journey card tooltip positioning fix. Tooltip is rendered via createPortal to document.body (parent=BODY confirmed), and appears immediately adjacent (delta x=+20, y=+19.6 from cell top-left) to the hovered cell for both a scheduled test day and an empty day. Correct content: 'Wed Sep 16 2026 · Mock JEE Test 1' on the blue cell, and 'Mon Sep 21 2026 · No test scheduled · click to add' on an empty cell. Horizontal flow of journey days confirmed (grid-auto-flow: row; cells share y and increase x).
seed_data_creation: None (used existing 'Mock JEE Test 1' near today+5)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journey tooltip is portaled to body and positioned via fixed left=hover.x+14, top=hover.y+14. Verified across scheduled and empty cells. Horizontal flow intact.
rca of the issue: Original issue: tooltip rendered inside a react-grid-layout item whose CSS transform breaks position:fixed containing block, causing tooltip to appear at bottom of card. Fix: createPortal(tooltip, document.body) so fixed positioning is relative to the viewport. Confirmed by inspecting tooltip.parentElement.tagName === 'BODY' and bounding box proximity to the hovered cell.
